title: CreatorTwinActions
description: W5 remainder: IPC-twin actions (host_twin.rs). Local twins: <tool>.prepare {actions:[exactly 1]} -> change.apply (plan kind twin.change, undoClass none; the same UI command runs). Remote twins: generation.submit {kind, input, grantId} (Cost Gate first). The commands keep their own authz. Generated from TwinAction serde shape; Rust test w5f asserts type/required parity.

x-runtimeLifecycleProjection.note: phase is a verbatim projection of the existing runtime service. This is not a new process state machine. ready is true only when that service reports real L3 health.

runtime_status_result.description: Existing service observation plus revisioned owner read model. State enums and event are defined in local-engine-state.json. ready is real L3, independent from installationState.
